paragraphs: Sheridan College is one of Canada's leading post-secondary institutions, internationally renowned for its creative arts programs — particularly animation, game design, interaction design, and illustration. Founded in 1967 in Oakville, Ontario, Sheridan serves over 24,000 full-time students including a large international community.

Sheridan's Faculty of Animation, Arts and Design is consistently ranked among the world's top animation and design schools, producing alumni who have worked on major Hollywood productions at studios including Pixar, DreamWorks, and Walt Disney Animation. The college also offers strong programs in business, technology, and applied sciences.

International students at Sheridan benefit from dedicated international services, English for Academic Purposes programs, and placement at campuses in the Greater Toronto Area — one of Canada's most dynamic creative industries and technology hubs. Sheridan has extensive co-op and industry partnership programs.

Located in the Greater Toronto Area, Sheridan graduates benefit from proximity to Canada's largest concentration of animation studios, game development companies, and technology employers. International graduates from eligible programs qualify for the Post-Graduation Work Permit and Ontario immigration pathways.
paragraphsRu: Sheridan College — один из ведущих постсреднеобразовательных институтов Канады, всемирно известный программами творческих искусств: анимации, геймдизайна, дизайна взаимодействий и иллюстрации. Основан в 1967 году в Оквилле, Онтарио.
Факультет анимации, искусств и дизайна Sheridan последовательно входит в число лучших анимационных и дизайнерских школ мира. Выпускники работают в Pixar, DreamWorks и Walt Disney Animation.
Иностранные студенты Sheridan получают специализированные международные услуги и доступ к богатейшей экосистеме творческих индустрий Большого Торонто.
Выпускники соответствующих программ имеют право на Post-Graduation Work Permit и иммиграционные программы Онтарио.
